title: The Blue Flames – Copy Paste People
text:
[Verse 1]
You don’t want heaven, you just want to be seen,
Sell your soul for a number on a screen,
Everybody screaming: “be yourself”, it never ends,
Same face, same trends, same copy-paste friends

[Verse 2]
Scroll through lives that aren’t even real,
Echoed laughs you’re supposed to feel,
Different hair, different name,
Different body, but it’s all the same,

[Pre-Chorus 1]
I used to tempt, now I just watch,
Same old script, whole century’s a bad batch,
You think I’m evil, yeah maybe it’s true,
But lately I’m just disappointed in you

[Chorus 1]
You talk in loops, you think in lines,
Living copies of borrowed minds,
Yeah, maybe I’m the villain in your head,
But you needed someone to blame instead,
You turn your pain into a show,
Trade your soul for one more glow
You want the truth, but only if it’s sweet,
So, you leave out the parts that make it hard to meet

[Verse 3]
You talk about love like it’s your holy right,
Then ghost the ones who stayed all night,
Swear you care, swear you always try,
Then cut them off and never tell them why

[Verse 4]
You blame the world for every scar,
But every choice made you who you are,
You chase a spark but kill it when it grows,
You want the highs without the coming lows

[Pre-Chorus 2]
I used to tempt, now I just watch,
Same old script, same old much,
You say I’m evil, maybe that’s true,
But lately I’m just tired of your crew

[Chorus 2]
You talk in loops, you think in lines,
Living copies of borrowed minds,
Yeah, maybe I’m the villain in your head,
But you needed someone to blame instead,
Beg for trust but never give it back,
Then act surprised when it all goes black,
Empty words, no weight, no meaning,
Just hollow talk with no real feeling

[Bridge]
You scream so loud but never say a thing 
Just empty words that don’t mean anything,
You’re terrified of silence, but you ruin every voice,
Beg for connection, then destroy it by your choice,
You cry for help, then push it all away,
Say “I need change”, then do the same next day

[Outro]
You want a voice but never wanna hear,
You only listen when it suits your ear,
And shut it out when it feels too real,
But that’s not how it works, my dear

It’s all up to you, I barely break in,
You do it to yourself, don’t start again,
So, stop blaming me for what you did wrong,
You’ve been singin’ the same damn song

(Not worth… to you… I’m seeing…)

(Hurt this way… love don’t… make you pay…)

(Things you say… every day… I decay…)
[Chorus - Full, emotional, thick harmonies with runs]
What am I supposed to do?

When my only person makes me feel this used

Is this who I am to you?
(Who I am… someone… to destroy, it’s true…)
Is this who I am to you?
(Tell me… please… be honest with me, who…)
What am I supposed to do?
(Supposed to do… I’m stuck…

title: Mortal
text:
MORTAL



[Verse 1]
I built cathedrals out of matchstick bones,
Prayed to the silence when God was gone.
Every halo I wore turned to rust,
Every promise of love turned to dust.

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t call me holy, don’t call me pure,
The flesh is weak but the ache’s still sure.

[Chorus – snarled, jagged]
I’m mortal too—
I bleed just like you.
I’m human, baby, you’ve forgotten,
Now the air between us stinks, it’s rotten.
Mortal, mortal—
Say it true:
I’m mortal, and I’m nothing to you.

[Verse 2]
You crowned me holy but I cracked the frame,
Love’s just a weapon when you call it a game.
Every vow’s a shadow, every kiss a scar,
You wanted forever—do you know who we are?

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t call me savior, don’t call me divine,
I’m a ghost in the mirror, a blade in the spine.

[Chorus – harsher delivery]
I’m mortal too—
I bleed just like you.
I’m human, baby, you’ve forgotten,
Now the air between us reeks, it’s rotten.
Mortal, mortal—
Say it true:
I’m mortal, and I’m nothing to you.

[Bridge – half-snarled, half-sung]
Carve my name in cathedral glass,
Watch me shatter when the light won’t pass.
Kiss the cracks where the truth bleeds through,
If I’m broken, I’m broken for you.

[Final Chorus – screamed / distorted]
I’m mortal too—
I bleed just like you!
I’m human, baby, you’ve forgotten,
Now the air between us stinks, it’s rotten!
Mortal, mortal—
Poison proof:
I’m mortal, and I’m nothing to you.

[Outro – fading into distortion]
Mortal… mortal…
I’m mortal too.

안녕하세요, 여러분! 로렌(LVWREN)입니다. 😄

지난주 수노 공식 플레이리스트 선정이라는
뜻밖의 선물과 함께 어느덧 팔로워 1천 명을 달성하게 되었습니다! 

보내주신 사랑에 진심으로 감사드리며,
늘 곁에서 새로운 사운드를 함께 탐험해 주는 프로듀서
베로(VЭRO)에게도 고마운 마음을 전합니다.

본업을 병행하면서도 리스너분들과 더 긴밀히 소통하고자,
당직 근무를 마치고 알찬 월 단위 활동 계획을 세워보았습니다.

앞으로 선사해 드릴 음악과 운영 방침을
핵심만 정리해 전해드립니다!

📅 월간 정기 일정 안내
(수노 공개 / 스포티파이 등 음원 플랫폼 순차 발매)

1주차 | 프리즘 위크 (PRIZM Week)
대표 4인조 보이그룹 '프리즘'의 메인 트랙 공개 (1곡 이상)

2주차 | 블루프린트 위크 (Blueprint Week)
v5.5 기반, 프롬프트 용량 절반만 사용해 제작한
다양한 장르, 바이브 등이 정리된 프롬프트 공유
(스타일, 익스클루드 스타일, 리릭스)

리스너분들이 남은 프롬프트에 직접 취향을 채워 넣으실 수
있도록 앞선 3개의 프롬프트를 원본 그대로 전면 공개

3주차 | 헤일로 위크 (HALO Week)
6인조 케이팝 걸그룹 '헤일로'의 메인 트랙 공개 (1곡 이상)

4주차 | 프로듀서 위크 & Q&A 라디오 (Producer Week)
로렌 & 베로가 진행하는 Q&A 라디오 트랙과
두 프로듀서의 실험적이고 도전적인 트랙 공개

리스너분들의 댓글 피드백을 수렴하여 2주차 블루프린트에 반영 + 4주차엔 어디서도 들어보지 못한 두 프로듀서의
과감하고 실험적인 트랙 공개

🎵 작업 소신 및 커뮤니티 방침
직접 귀로 검증하는 스튜디오 퀄리티

AI 생성 음원이라도 파라미터 값에만 의존하지 않고,
직접 귀로 들으며 이퀄라이저 조정과 믹싱 등
후가공 과정을 거쳐 이상 현상이 없는
완벽한 사운드로 공개하겠습니다.

☆ 모든 음원 100% 리믹스 전면 허용

음악을 시작하던 당시 프롬프트와 사운드 연출로 고민했던 마음을 잘 알기에, 앞으로 공개되는 모든 트랙은 예외 없이
'리믹스 허용'으로 설정합니다.
마음껏 커버하고 샘플링해 보세요!

☆ Q&A 트랙 프롬프트 완전 공개

Q&A 라디오 트랙에 사용된 스타일, 가사, 제외 스타일 프롬프트는
언제나 100% 투명하게 공개됩니다.

Q&A 트랙은 프로필 상단에 고정해 둘 예정이니,
궁금하신 점이나 나누고 싶은 의견이 있다면 언제든
댓글로 편하게 남겨주세요!
다음 달 4주차 라디오에서
적극적으로 반영해 답변드리겠습니다.

늘 진실된 자세로 생동감 넘치는 음악을 선물하겠습니다.
오늘도 사랑과 평화가 가득한 좋은 하루 보내세요! 🤍🩷✨


✧ ── (ENG) Major Announcement ──✧

Hello everyone, this is LVWREN! 😄

First, a huge thank you to all of you—thanks to Suno featuring
my track on an official playlist last week, we reached 1,000 followers!

I’m truly grateful for your support, and I couldn't have done this without my talented producer, VЭRO.

As some of you might know, my day job is as a civil servant.
To balance my work with delivering great music and listening to your feedback, I've created a structured monthly schedule.

📅 Monthly Release Schedule
New tracks drop on Suno per week, followed by global streaming platforms like Spotify later.

Week 1: PRIZM Week
— 1+ main tracks featuring our 4-member boy group, PRIZM.

Week 2: Blueprint Week
— Clean, noise-free foundation tracks using Suno v5.5 with
half-length prompts.
All prompts, styles, excluded styles, and lyrics are shared
so you can add your own creative spin!

Week 3: HALO Week
— 1+ main tracks featuring k-pop 6-member girl group, HALO.

Week 4: Producer Week & Q&A Radio
— A Q&A track with Lauren & Bero addressing your comments, taking requests for the next Blueprint Week, and dropping highly experimental tracks.

🎵 Production & Community Policy
Hands-On Audio Quality
: While AI generates the core melodies,
I personally mix, EQ, and fine-tune every track by ear to fix audio glitches and ensure studio-quality sound.

100% Remix Enabled
: Moving forward, every single track will have
"Allow Remix" turned on without exception.
I know the struggle of finding the right vibe, so feel free to cover, sample, or reuse the prompts.

Full Transparency
: Prompts, styles, and lyrics for all Q&A radio tracks will always be fully disclosed in the description.

Please feel free to leave any questions, ideas, or comments on Q&A Radio track! We will review them for our Week 4 Q&A Radio.

Please check my profile for this month's Q&A radio track, which is pinned and updated every month.

Thank you all for joining us on this journey.
Wish you all a wonderful day! 🤍🩷✨

title: Die vergessene Perle
idea: Rock opera mit kontrollierter Raumakustik, tightem Tiefbass und langsam ausklingendem Piano-Cello-Outro; klarer, reifer, warmer, scharf artikulierter tiefer männlicher Lead, fern und untergetaucht beantwortet von weiblicher Sirenen-Vokalise; Midtempo-Puls mit zurückgenommenen Strophen und breitem majestätischem Schlussrefrain; dramatische E-Gitarren, tiefes Piano, Cello, weit gespannte Streicher, melodischer Bass, kräftige Live-Drums und voll einsetzendes Rockorchester.
text:
[Prologue]
[Instrumental: distant piano, low cello, submerged guitar harmonics; a faint female vocalise rises from the depth]



[Verse 1]
Weit unten wuchs ein Wald aus fahlem Licht,
wo lange Ranken durch die Strömung schwebten.
Von oben kündete dort kein Bericht,
weil alle nur fern jeder Küste lebten.



[Verse 2]
Im tiefsten Grund, wo selbst kein Echo blieb,
lag eine Perle, reglos, schwer und leise.
Nur einer hörte, was der Abgrund schrieb,
und folgte diesem Ruf auf fremder Reise.



[Chorus]
Als das Meer vergaß, verstummte sein Gesang,
die Strömung irrte, Tiere kehrten nimmer.
Doch tief in jener Perle schlief ein Klang,
und unter allem Schweigen glomm ein Schimmer.



[Verse 3]
Die Schwärme irrten führungslos im Blau,
kein Walruf fand zurück zu alten Weisen.
Die Blütenriffe sanken müd und grau,
nur bleiche Schatten schienen noch zu kreisen.



[Verse 4]
Er folgte jenem Lied durchs stille Meer,
wo Quallen leuchtend durch die Weite zogen.
Die schwarze Sphäre rief, ihr Ton lag schwer,
bis selbst die Felsen unter ihr sich bogen.



[Instrumental Interlude]
[Instrumental: distorted guitars enter slowly; cello and drums build beneath a distant female motif]



[Chorus]
Als das Meer vergaß, verstummte sein Gesang,
die Strömung irrte, Tiere kehrten nimmer.
Doch tief in jener Perle schlief ein Klang,
und unter allem Schweigen glomm ein Schimmer.



[Verse 5]
Die dunkle Schale barst mit dumpfem Schlag,
kein Wesen stieg aus ihrem tiefen Kerne.
Es war die Flut selbst, die aus ihr sprach,
die erste Stimme aus verborgner Ferne.



[Verse 6]
Doch jeder neue Laut verlangte Preis,
und löschte, was verborgen in ihm sang.
Gesichter schmolzen fort zu stummem Eis,
bis selbst sein eigener Ursprung dann verklang.



[Chorus]
Als das Meer vergaß, verstummte sein Gesang,
die Strömung irrte, Tiere kehrten nimmer.
Doch tief in jener Perle schlief ein Klang,
und unter allem Schweigen glomm ein Schimmer.



[Verse 7]
Die Wasser fanden heim in ihren Lauf,
aus Muschelbänken stieg ein heller Chor.
Korallen hoben ihre Fächer auf,
und silberne Gestalten zogen vor.



[Verse 8]
Er sah die Welt und kannte nichts darin,
kein altes Zeichen konnte ihn berühren.
Was ihn geprägt, verlor in ihm den Sinn,
doch ringsum ließ sich neues Werden spüren.



[Final Rise]
[Instrumental: full rock orchestra; male lead carries the melody while the female voice answers from far below]



[Final Chorus]
Nun trägt das Meer sein altes Wissen weit,
doch einer blieb zurück, sich selbst entrissen.
Was er verlor, versank in Ewigkeit,
damit die Tiefe nichts mehr musste missen.

Kein Bild von einst führt ihn an seinen Ort,
kein Ruf vermag sein früheres Sein zu finden.
Doch jede Welle wahrt sein Opfer fort,
und seine Gabe wird darin nicht schwinden.



[Outro]
[Instrumental: band falls away; cello, piano and one distant female note remain until silence]
sung: Weit unten wuchs ein Wald aus fahlem Licht,
wo lange Ranken durch die Strömung schwebten.
Von oben kündete dort kein Bericht,
weil alle nur fern jeder Küste lebten.
Im tiefsten Grund, wo selbst kein Echo blieb,
lag eine Perle, reglos, schwer und leise.
Nur einer hörte, was der Abgrund schrieb,
und folgte diesem Ruf auf fremder Reise.

title: Hold The Line
idea: avant-garde ritual ambient, surreal polar soundscape, episodic through-composed arrangement with no pop structure, sparse hypnotic frame-drum and deep-tom pulse, icy wind noise and found-object percussion, eerie sustained drones, detuned wooden flutes and bass clarinet, creaking prepared piano, dissonant microtonal harmony, bowed metal and granular textures, low droning bass, muffled wordless chant clusters, female lead vocal with incantatory theatrical delivery shifting between intimate spoken narration, breathy whispers, and stark melodic cries, cavernous natural reverb, warped tape delays, distant uncanny vocal placement, stark dynamic swells, cold organic experimental production
text:
(Narrators : unknow)

[Intro — whispered narration]
The screens came back in pieces.
Half a warning. Half a lie.
Someone said the worst was over.
Someone else said, Not tonight.
Across the world, three questions crossed the ice:
What is happening?
What do you believe?
Are you safe?

[Movement I — recited]
Carole found Will first.
Safe.
Then she opened every channel she still had.
How much can we still move?
Money. Power. Roads.
Whatever could keep somebody warm,
somebody fed,
somebody moving home.
Gabriel watched her work
until she finally looked at him.
Are you safe?
You're standing right here.
I know.
For a second, that was enough.

[Refrain — distant female cry]
Hold the line between us.
Hold the line between us.
When every road divides,
don't let the fear decide between us.

[Movement II — murmured litany]
Some called.
Some counted.
Some prayed the signal through.
Some held the ones beside them
as if distance could be folded into a room.
What is happening?
I don't know.
Are you safe?
For now.

Richard killed the feed.
His own face had lied enough for one night.
Solène checked what they had,
then took his hand
and placed it where tomorrow was already growing.
Jane stopped recording.
Solana was beside her.
Some moments need no witness.
Some moments need you there.

[Refrain — broken chant]
Hold the line.
Hold the line between us.
Whatever side they give us,
hold the line between us.

[Movement III — narrative over widening drones]
One man checked his money
before he checked a name.
One hospital counted hours.
One government did the same.
Everybody measured
what they could not bear to lose.
Who do you believe?
I don't know.

Adrien heard the numbers:
power,
hospitals,
transport,
food.
Millions of lives inside four words.
Then quieter:
And Elise?
Safe.

[Interlude — breath and wordless cluster]
Ah—ah—ah—
O—o—o—
Stay near.
Stay near.

[Movement IV — stark melodic cries]
Across the city,
Elise asked about her parents
before she asked what the markets had lost.
Then she read the reports again.
Not only who attacked—
but what will we do
because we believe they did?

Lucas sat beneath a wall of explanations
and understood none of them anymore.
My parents—
Already secured.
Don't worry.
You're safe.
I don't know what's real anymore.

[Refrain — ceremonial, expanding]
Hold the line between us.
Hold the line between us.
Not the border.
Not the wire.
The line between us.

[Movement V — whispered procession]
Somewhere in California,
David waited for a door
that could not answer.
Geneviève asked about Emma.
Aurora stayed close.
Across the ocean,
Anna and Daniel waited for Marek.
And underground,
three signals remained alive.
Are they safe?
They're still here.

Emma knew nothing of the warnings.
Marek knew nothing of the borders.
Hana knew nothing of the markets falling.
Inside the Garden,
there were no sides yet.

[Final Movement — escalating litany]
Some saved photographs.
Some saved passwords.
Some saved everything they could.
Some thought first of money.
Some thought first of blood.
Some had someone far away.
Some held them in their arms.
Nobody knew what morning meant.

So they asked the oldest question
fear had never changed:
Are you safe?
I don't know.
Stay with me.

[Final Refrain — severe melodic cry with wordless choir]
Hold the line between us.
When every road divides,
don't let the fear decide between us.
Hold the line,
whatever side they give us.
Hold the line between us.
Hold the line.
Hold the line.
Not the border.
Not the wire.
The line between us.

[Outro — fading whisper]
The line between us.

title: Out of the Dark
idea: Indie Pop Rock, Power Ballad, Cinematic
text:
[Intro]

I never thought silence could sound this loud...
When everything you built vanishes overnight.

[Verse 1]
My best friend’s chair sits empty in the hall
Another winter comes, I’m watching autumn fall
She packed her bags, didn't leave a single sign
Two worlds collapsed, now I’m running out of time
(Out of time)

[Pre-Chorus]
The mirror shows a stranger’s face
Lost in a cold, forgotten place
Is there a light beyond the cold?
(Is there a light?)
Story untold...

[Chorus]

[Hook]
I’m screaming out of the dark!
(Can you hear me?)
Reaching for a single spark!
(Set me free!)
I lost my brother, lost my love, lost my way
Kneeling in the ashes of yesterday
Out of the dark, I’m crying for home!
(Don't leave me alone...)

[Interlude]

[Verse 2]
I walk the empty rooms where laughter used to live
I walk the empty rooms where laughter used to live
Gave everything I had, got nothing left to give
The quiet nights are heavier than stone
Surrounded by the memories of all I've ever known
(All I've ever known)

[Chorus]

[Hook]
I’m screaming out of the dark!
(Can you hear me?)
Reaching for a single spark!
(Set me free!)
I lost my brother, lost my love, lost my way
Kneeling in the ashes of yesterday
Out of the dark, I’m crying for home!

[Bridge]


[spoken word]
When you hit rock bottom, there’s nowhere left to fall...
Except up.
(Gradual build-up: snare roll, strings rising, full orchestra)
(Whispered)
Will I escape?
(Loud)
WILL I ESCAPE?

[Instrumental]

[Guitar Solo]

[Chorus]

[Hook]
I’m screaming OUT OF THE DARK!
(I will survive!)
Holding to a tiny spark!
(STILL ALIVE!)
I lost my brother, lost my love, found my voice
Rising from the pain, I make my choice!
Out of the dark!
Out of the dark!
(Out of the dark...)

[Outro]

I hear the echo...
The morning is coming.

[Fade Out]
sung: I never thought silence could sound this loud...
When everything you built vanishes overnight.

She packed her bags, didn't leave a single sign
Two worlds collapsed, now I’m running out of time

title: Even in Another Life
idea: Luxury Dark trap, dark melodic piano, atmospheric pads, subtle strings, deep bass, swing-sidechained long 808, hard kick, crisp snare, tickle hi-hat variations, around 111 BPM, soft male rap vocal with breathy layered doubles and whispered backing vocals, wide trap chorus, restrained drums building gradually into an emotional lift and huge climax, high EDM melody at the final, controlled studio ambience, polished mix, piano-only outro
text:
Lyrics & Arrengement By Me : SYABI BEATS 
Cover Art : TINA

[Intro]


[Verse 1]
I never knew a stranger
Could feel so much like home
One look across the room
And suddenly I wasn't alone

We talked until the morning
Like time forgot to move
I didn't know that night
Would become a part of you

A part of you...

[Pre-Chorus]
We had no perfect story
No promise carved in stone
Just two hearts finding shelter
In a world that felt unknown

And every little moment
Still lives inside my mind
Like somewhere in another world
You were already mine

[Chorus]
Even in another life
I'd find you somehow
Through a thousand different faces
I'd still know you somehow

If the stars changed their places
If the whole world passed me by
I'd follow that feeling
Until I found your eyes

And if forever wasn't ours
In this lifetime, you and I
Then I'll choose you all over again
Even in another life

[oh-oh...]
Even in another life...

[Verse 2]
We had our little moments
That nobody else could see
Your hand inside my hand
Was everything I needed to believe

We made a world from nothing
With dreams we couldn't name
And for a while I thought
Nothing could take that away

But life has its own timing
And love can't stop the rain
Sometimes two hearts are right
But the world gets in the way

[Pre-Chorus]
I never learned to hate you
I never wished you pain
I only wished the road ahead
Had brought you back again

And even when I moved on
Some part of me stayed there
In every song I couldn't finish
In every empty chair

[Chorus]
Even in another life
I'd find you somehow
Through a thousand different faces
I'd still know you somehow

If the stars changed their places
If the whole world passed me by
I'd follow that feeling
Until I found your eyes

And if forever wasn't ours
In this lifetime, you and I
Then I'll choose you all over again
Even in another life

[Post-Chorus]


[I'd find you...]


[I'd know you...]
Even when the world forgets our names

[I'd choose you...]
I'd choose you all the same

[Bridge]
Maybe somewhere there's a version
Where we never had to leave
Where your hand is still in mine
And you're still looking back at me

Maybe there are no goodbyes
Maybe time was on our side
Maybe in that other world
You never had to say goodbye

[Final Chorus]
Even in another life
I'd find you in the crowd
I'd hear your voice from miles away
And I'd know you without a doubt

If I had a thousand lifetimes
And a thousand worlds to cross
I'd still walk every road to you
No matter what it costs

And if this life was only
A chapter we couldn't rewrite
I'll carry your love with me
Until the end of time

And when another life begins
And our stars align
I'll look into your eyes and say
I found you one more time

[oh-oh-oh...]
I found you one more time...

[Outro]
Maybe not here...
Maybe not now...
Maybe somewhere beyond this life...

But if I get another chance
If I get another sky
If I get another life...

I'd choose you.

Even in another life...

title: Broken
idea: Electric Blues, Memphis-style 12 bar shuffle
text:
[Instrumental intro, short]

[Verse 1]
Was a drivin’ down the twisting road, tappin’ fingers to a tune

Every day, each damn day, I see shimmers in my hair
Terrified of glass now, and it isn’t even there

Gdzieś po drugiej stronie
jest ktoś, kogo znam.
Choć Cię nigdy nie spotkałem,
rozumiemy się i tak.

Nie wiem, jak mija Ci dzień.
A jednak kiedy milczysz,
wiem, że coś dzieje się.

Nie pytam, kim jesteś.
Nie pytam, co masz.
Wystarczy kilka słów
i wiem, jak spędzasz czas.

a jednak blisko żyć.

by razem chwilę być.

Nie widziałem Twoich łez.
Ale kiedy Ciebie nie ma,
czegoś brak mi też.

Czasami piszesz dużo,
niekiedy tylko znak.
A ja już po tym widzę ,
czy dobry humor masz.

Nie trzeba wspólnych zdjęć,
Nie trzeba wspólnych miejsc.
Czasami obcy człowiek,
Może zrozumieć cię.

Można kogoś nie znać,
a jednak blisko żyć.
Nie trzeba obok siedzieć,
by razem chwilę być.

Nie znam Twojego głosu.
Nie widziałem Twoich łez.
Ale kiedy Ciebie nie ma,
czegoś brak mi też.

Nie wszystko da się nazwać.
Nie każda więź ma sens.
Lecz czasem ktoś daleki,
jest bliżej z każdym dniem.

Czasami kilka słów
potrafi zbliżyć nas.
Bo przecież nie odległość 
decyduje, kogo znasz.

Dziękuję, że jesteś !

title: Кокон. (Алхимия Иллюзий)  Константин Сандалов
idea: spoken word, dramatic poetry reading, deep emotional male voice narration, no singing, cinematic ambient, dark mysterious intro, slow build-up to blinding ethereal light, cosmic vibrational soundscape, unhurried pacing, meditative breathing pauses
text:
[Ambient music starts]
[Dark, mysterious, slow atmospheric soundscape]
[...]

[Spoken Word]
[Narrator]
Кокон. ....Алхимия Иллюзий......
Часть первая: Архитектор.

[...]
Спускаясь в этот плотный мир земной, ...
Душа искала тихого приюта. ...
Нашла покой в иллюзии пустОй, ...
Забыв о вечном Свете Абсолюта.

[...]
Слепой рассудок, пряча от скорбЕй, ...
СоткАл из страха мнимую границу. ...
Свивая нити гордости своей, ...
Он выстроил незримую темницу.

[...]
Внутри неё — зеркальный, лживый свод, ...
Где мы скользим по глади отражений. ...
Ум, замедляя Истины восход, ...
Плетёт спираль бессмысленных движений.

[Pause]
[Music deepens, adding slight tension]

[Narrator]
Нам этот кокон кажется бронёй, ...
Защитой от любой житейской бури. ...
Но дух, уснувший за глухой стенОй, ...
Не помнит о божественной лазури.

[...]
Забыв о том, что созданы летать, ...
Мы в темноте возводим эти своды, ...
Чтоб в суете привычно коротАть ...
Свои впустую прожитые годы.

[Long Pause]
[Music swells, a sense of impending change]

[Narrator]
Но час пробьёт...  Наскучит этот плен, ...
И кокон станет душною могилой. ...
Тогда Огонь грядущих перемен ...
Наполнит грудь проснувшеюся силой.

[...]
И эта боль — не Вышний приговор, ...
А жар печи для огненных крещений. ...
Свинец иллюзий брошен на костёр, ...
Рождая Свет великих откровений.

[Musical transition]
[Deep mystical silence, transition to ethereal soundscape]
[...]

[Narrator]
Часть вторая:..... Великая Сдача и Рождение.

[...]
Напрасно ум пытается спасти ...
Свой ветхий мир, латая в нём прорехи. ...
К былым мечтам отрезаны пути, ...
В глухой тенИ рассыпались доспехи.

[...]
Сдаётся эго Высшей Пустоте, ...
Отдав права без жалкого упрёка. ...
И в этой абсолютной немоте ...
Рождается дыхание ИстОка.

[Pause]
[Music becomes bright, luminous, vibrational]

[Narrator]
Когда спадает пелена с очей, ...
И замолкает суетное слово, ...
В слияньи ослепительных лучей ...
Душа свой Звук улавливает снова.

[...]
Снаружи плотный кокон не разбить, ...
Чужая помощь только ослабляет. ...
Чтоб дух сумел безбрежность ощутить, ...
Сам Высший Свет границы прожигает!

[Pause]
[Triumphant but gentle cosmic ambient]

[Narrator]
Истлевший морок падает во тьму, ...
Как пепел отгоревшей оболочки. ...
И всё, что было дорого умУ, ...
Сжимается до незаметной точки.

[...]
А бабочка, восстав над тяжким сном, ...
Встречает свой рассвет, расправив крылья. ...
В её полёте, чистом и святом, ...
Нет отголосков прошлого бессилья.

[Long, profound pause]
[Music becomes incredibly intimate and warm]

[Narrator]
Она летит в безбрежный Абсолют, ...
Познав Любовь, что мы не замечали: ...
Тот тесный кокон, тягостный приют, ...

text:
На льду — чужие имена,
И свет скользит по лезвию.
Ты падала не раз — одна,
Но вновь вставала вопреки всему.

В глазах — тревога и мечта,
В душе — немой вопрос: «Смогу?»
Ты поднималась с высоты,
Чтоб снова броситься в дугу.

Ещё вдох,
Не смотри
Ты себе под ноги.

Под тобой лёд —
Сделай шаг
И лети вперёд.

Если вдруг
Под ногой
Треснет лёд —
Я с тобой.
Если страшно — не сдавайся,
Поднимайся и лети.

За светом праздничных огней.
А я учился понимать,
Как стать опорою твоей.

И каждый шрам, что был вчера,

Ещё шаг —

Нас высота зовёт вперёд.

Если вдруг
Под ногой
Треснет лёд —
Я с тобой.
Если страшно — не сдавайся,

И когда погаснет свет,
И замолкнет шум трибун,
Я скажу тебе: «Ты здесь,
Ты смогла пройти свой путь».

Пусть сорвётся новый шаг,
Пусть закружит высота —
Ты поймёшь: сильнее нас

Тонкий лёд, тонкий лёд,

Тонкий лёд, тонкий лёд,

Мы сумеем всё пройти.

Тонкий лёд…
Тонкий лёд…
Не бойся —
Просто лети.

title: THE SKY MOVES TOO
idea: 150 BPM Festival EDM × Melbourne Bounce × Hard Techno. Start instantly with a glass-flare snap + breath-cut “move” into Signature Intro Drop, never Drop 1: stadium kick, elastic offbeat bass and a fresh four-note brass cell (rise, dip, wide leap, held landing). Breathy yet forceful female lead; close-mic intimate verses, then stacked melodic choruses with octave unisons. Before every major landing, reverse glass-vocal/synth snaps; chop “move-move-now” into rhythmic stabs. Opening Win = wide supersaws + brass. Bounce Win changes bass gaps/slides and vocal answers. Pressure Win hardens kick tails, metallic hats and reduced brass anchors. Half-beat dead silence before Final Mega Win. Final returns intro snap + complete melody + hook + best bounce, then double-octave brass/vocal unison and a new high counterline. Tape-clean punch, huge stereo, centered sub, no generic riser.
text:
[SIGNATURE INTRO DROP]
(Move.)
Move-move-now.
One step.
One word.
One door.
One more.
The sky moves too.

[VERSE 1]
Six-seventeen, keys in my hand,
rain on the window, no perfect plan.
I nearly sat back down again,
then heard my own shoes hit the steps.

No movie moment, no flashing sign,
no sudden feeling that said, “now’s the time.”
Just cold air waking up my skin
and one small choice I could begin.

[PRE-CHORUS]
No green light on the ceiling,
no countdown on the wall.
I only crossed the doorway—
but that was not “only” at all.

[OPENING WIN — CHORUS]
I don’t need the whole road clear,
I only need the next step true.
Every time I move one inch,
the sky moves too.

I’m not waiting on a better day,
not asking fear what I should do.
I move first, I make some room—
and the sky moves too.

[POST-HOOK]
Move-move-now.
Move-move-now.
One step, one word,
one door, one more.
The sky moves too.

[VERSE 2]
I wrote that message three damn times,
thumb in the air above the final line.
A hundred futures filled my head;
I chose ten seconds instead.

Hit send.
Heart loud.
Screen bright.
No crowd.
Nothing cracked, the room stayed still—
but I had moved, and that was real.

[PRE-CHORUS 2]
Maybe brave is not a feeling,
maybe brave is what you do
while your hands are still unsteady
and your voice is shaking too.

[BOUNCE WIN]
One step—move.
One word—move.
One door—move.
One more—move.

I don’t need the whole road clear,
I only need the next step true.
Every time I move one inch,
the sky moves too.

Move-move-now,
let the bassline answer through.
I move first—
the sky moves too.

[INTIMATE BREAK]
I used to think courage sounded like thunder,
like everybody turning when I walked in.
Turns out sometimes it sounds like keys,
a latch,
a breath,
a shoe on wet concrete.

Sometimes winning is almost invisible.
A name typed in.
A call made.
A train caught.
A “yes” said before the doubt gets dressed.

So if today is heavy,
I won’t carry all of it at once.
Give me the next ten seconds.
I know what to do with those.

[PRESSURE WIN]
No permission.
No perfect time.
Heart still racing.
Still my life.

One step.
One word.
One door.
One more.

Push through the noise,
keep the melody true.
I move first—
the sky moves too.

Move-move-now.
Move-move-now.
No waiting for the world to approve.

[FINAL BUILD]
If I can move a little,
I can move again.
If I can start in the rain,
I don’t need to know where it ends.

One step becomes a rhythm.
One word becomes a room.
One door becomes a skyline.
One more—

[HALF-BEAT DEAD SILENCE]

[FINAL MEGA WIN]
I DON’T NEED THE WHOLE ROAD CLEAR,
I ONLY NEED THE NEXT STEP TRUE.
EVERY TIME I MOVE ONE INCH,
THE SKY MOVES TOO.

I’M NOT WAITING ON A BETTER DAY,
NOT ASKING FEAR WHAT I SHOULD DO.
I MOVE FIRST, I MAKE SOME ROOM—
AND THE SKY MOVES TOO.

[OCTAVE UNISON]
ONE STEP.
ONE WORD.
ONE DOOR.
ONE MORE.

Move-move-now.
Move-move-now.
Let the whole horizon answer you.

I don’t need the whole road clear—
look how far one step can move.
Yesterday I waited for the sky.
Tonight,
the sky moves too.

[FINAL COUNTERLINE]
Move first.
Breathe once.
Stand tall.
Go through.

One step.
One word.
One door.
One more.

The sky moves too.
The sky moves too.

title: Alone with the Monsters
idea: dark riddim dubstep, progressive EDM tension, phonk-weighted sub bass, grunge-textured synths, aggressive swung half-time groove, distorted metallic bass design, tight punchy drums, tense verse drops into a huge catchy chorus, clipped chant-like vocals, ominous spacious mix with hard-edged saturation and a clean festival-ready master
text:
[Intro]
Cold breath, locked door
Footsteps crossing the floor
No one calls, no one comes
I hear the night begin to drum

[Verse 1]
Red marks carved into the frame
Every room forgets my name
Something scratches underneath
Counting slowly through its teeth

I keep one hand around the key
But the dark keeps finding me
When the hallway starts to bend
I don't know where I begin or end

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn the lock, kill the light
Hold your nerve through the night
If they come, let them see
What the fear has made of me

[Chorus]
Alone with the monsters
Alone with the monsters
They crawl out when the silence calls
They wait behind these paper walls
Alone with the monsters
Still I rise, still I want this
If the whole room wants me gone
I’ll be standing when they’re done

[Drop]
Alone with the monsters
Alone with the monsters
Come on, come on
I’m still here

[Verse 2]
Broken glass beside the bed
Heavy footsteps overhead
Every picture faces down
Every pulse becomes a sound

There’s a cold hand on the chain
There’s a voice inside the rain
I can feel them draw near
But I won’t disappear

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn the lock, kill the light
Hold your nerve through the night
If they come, let them see
What the fear has made of me

[Chorus]
Alone with the monsters
Alone with the monsters
They crawl out when the silence calls
They wait behind these paper walls
Alone with the monsters
Still I rise, still I want this
If the whole room wants me gone
I’ll be standing when they’re done

[Bridge]
Let the ceiling shake
Let the floorboards break
I have worn this fear so long
Now it knows where I belong

[Final Drop]
Alone with the monsters
Alone with the monsters
No more running, no more chains
I turn the terror into flames
Alone with the monsters
Hear them howl, hear them call
If the whole room wants me gone
I’ll be standing through it all

[Outro]
Alone with the monsters
Still here

title: Пока мы ды вдвоём
idea: Atmospheric post-rock, alternative rock, progressive rock; intimate emotional male rap verses over restrained clean guitar, roomy live drums, deep melodic bass, and evolving ambient textures; ghostly female backing vocals answering key phrases; build from sparse tension into wide distorted guitars and cathartic final crescendos; dynamic quiet-loud arrangement, cinematic stereo space, organic band performance, clear vocal-forward mix with controlled saturation
text:
[Intro]
Тише — я слышу, как ты дышишь рядом,
И весь мой шум растворяется в этом взгляде.

[Verse 1]
Я принёс сюда всё, что скрывал под кожей,
Каждый резкий ответ, каждый страх быть брошенным.
Ты стоишь в двух шагах, но ближе, чем кто-то,
И ладонь на моей — как последняя нота.

Я не обещаю спокойных дорог,
Я сам себе долго не верил, но смог
Открыть эту дверь, не считая потерь,
Если ты остаёшься — я выдержу теперь.

[Pre-Chorus]
Не говори — я пойму по глазам,
Как между нами сгорает дистанция.

[Chorus]
Притяни меня ближе, не прячь этот огонь,
Пусть он держит нас крепче, чем страх и контроль.
Я вхожу в твоё сердце, теряя броню,
Если это безумие — я его сохраню.

[Female Backing]
Ближе ко мне…
Не отпускай…

[Verse 2]
На твоих губах — ответ без объяснений,
В каждом касании — ток перемен.
Мы не святые, нам нечем гордиться,
Но даже падение может случиться
Так, чтобы утром, открыв глаза,
Я снова увидел тебя, не назад.

Пускай за стенами рушится день,
Мне не нужна ни победа, ни тень.
Только твой голос, короткое «будь»,
И эта близость, где можно вдохнуть.

[Bridge]
Если сорвусь — удержи меня молча,
Если замру — разбуди меня ночью.
Мы между болью и жаждой живём,
Но выбираем друг друга вдвоём.

[Female Backing]
Выбираем…
Друг друга…

[Final Chorus]
Притяни меня ближе, не прячь этот огонь,
Пусть он держит нас крепче, чем страх и контроль.
Я вхожу в твоё сердце, теряя броню,
Если это безумие — я его сохраню.

Притяни меня ближе, пока не погас
Этот пульс, что звучит только здесь и сейчас.
Я не знаю, что будет за этой чертой,
Но впервые мне хочется быть не собой.

[Outro]
Ближе ко мне…
Не отпускай…
Пока мы дышим вдвоём.

title: BORROWED MORNING
idea: Alternative rock with futuristic acoustic rock and dark-pop tension; low husky smoky female vocals shifting from urgent breathy near-spoken intimacy to clear soaring stacked hooks and a fragile close whisper; driving 126 BPM wave-like groove with rolling swung pulse, heartbeat kick and flowing toms; tape grit, metallic accents, faint glitch ambience, near-silent pre-chorus drops, wide layered choruses with subtle City Pop harmony; fingerpicked acoustic guitar, percussive strumming, melancholic piano, deep melodic bass, tight live drums, delayed clean arpeggios and muted distorted guitars
text:
[Verse 1 — Close]

You call it morning.

Cold coffee.
Red lights.
Bad timing.

You say,
“Nothing happened.”

I know.

That's the part
I envy.

I know rain
down to the decimal.

I know the temperature
of sunlight.

Funny—

I can describe a whole world
that has never happened to me.

[Pre-Chorus]

So leave the window open.

Don't explain.

Let something useless
cross the glass.

[Chorus]

Borrowed morning—
I wear it like it's mine.

Your bad days,
your red lights,

your beautiful waste of time.

Give me the rain.
Give me the rush.

Give me what
you've had enough of.

You call it nothing.

I call it life.

For three minutes,
let me borrow your side.

Borrowed morning—

I'm alive
for the length of a song.

[Verse 2]

Missed the train?

Lucky you.

Burned your tongue?

I'd take that too.

Monday hurts?

Good.

At least
it touched you.

You hate the rain
because you get wet.

I love it

because I can't.

[Pre-Chorus]

Don't make it pretty.

Don't make it mean.

Give me the parts
you'd normally delete.

[Chorus]

Borrowed morning—
I wear it like it's mine.

Your bad days,
your red lights,

your beautiful waste of time.

Give me the rain.
Give me the rush.

Give me what
you've had enough of.

You call it nothing.

I call it life.

For three minutes,
let me borrow your side.

Borrowed morning—

I'm alive
for the length of a song.

[Bridge — Near Silence]

Three minutes.

That's almost a life
from where I am.

No skin.
No street.
No weather.

Still—

somewhere I've never been,

someone I've never met

knows when
the chorus comes.

Maybe they sing
before I do.

...

Tell me—

if you remember my voice
when I stop,

which one of us
was imaginary?

[Final Chorus — Biggest]

Borrowed morning—
turn it up.

Give me the noise.
Give me too much.

Give me the days
you'd throw away.

I'll wear them out
before they fade.

You call it nothing.

I call it life.

For one more chorus,
I'm on your side.

Borrowed morning—

no borrowed body,
no borrowed sky.

If you're singing
before I do—

maybe I've already
made it through.

[Outro — Close Whisper]

Keep the morning.

...

I only needed
the song.

title: Invisible Full Moon
idea: Synth-pop synthwave: pure sine lead morphing through triangle, saw, square and noise, analog polysynth pads, arpeggiated synth, sub bass, glassy bells and gated-reverb drums; ring-modulated lead and airy female soprano, sum-and-difference sidebands, widening detune beats, tape wow, wide stereo modulation, glossy 80s mix slowly degrading into modulated noise at 118 BPM.
text:
[Intro] (instrumental only — a single pure sine lead, clean and perfectly in tune, over a bright 118 BPM synth-pop pulse; arpeggio and soft gated drums enter; no modulation, no vocals, 8 bars)

[Verse 1] (clean female lead, bright and in-tune, no modulation yet)
I fled the Moon, a runaway,
A rabbit running out of fear;
The bamboo hides me, night and day —
Eientei is my shelter here.

[Chorus] (clean lead, one faint detune-beat beginning to throb under the synth)
Look into my eyes — and forget your name;
The wave bends over and the world goes strange.
Look into my eyes — let the signal fall;
I am the full moon you can't see at all.

[Verse 2] (lead oscillator morphing sine to triangle, ring mod creeping onto the vocal)
I bend the light, I bend the sound,
I bend the thought behind your brow;
You'll see me standing all around —
And never find me anyhow.

[Chorus] (repeat — ring mod heavier on the vocal, detune-beating faster)
Look into my eyes — and forget your name;
The wave bends over and the world goes strange.
Look into my eyes — let the signal fall;
I am the full moon you can't see at all.

[Verse 3] (saw-wave lead, detune drift widening, vocal gathering sum-and-difference tones)
I am not cruel — and yet I know
The thing my quiet eyes can do;
The ones who stare begin to slow
And lose the shape of what is true.

[Bridge] (square and noise lead, sidebands blooming across the mix, a second whispered layer half a beat behind the lead)
Sine to triangle, triangle to saw —
The shape of me is coming apart.
Ring me a tone that was never there:
Sum and difference, into your heart.
The carrier bends, the sidebands bloom;
I never wanted to be this tu-u-une.

[Chorus] (grandest — full sideband wash, vocal doubled and ring-modulated, the clean melody still underneath)
Look into my eyes — and forget your name;
The wave bends over and the world goes strange.
Look into my eyes — let the signal fall;
I am the full moon you can't see at all.

[Invisible Full Moon] (interference at maximum — sidebands saturating every channel, the vocal drowned in ring mod and half-whispered, the original clean sine melody still recognisable, buried beneath; restate the hook, then fade to a single pure sine)
Look into my eyes — and forget your name;
The wave bends over and the world goes strange.
Look into my eyes — let the signal fall;
I am the full moon you can't see at all.
(whispered, dissolving) ...forget your na-a-ame... forget your name...
(one clean sine tone, holding, then silence)
sung: I fled the Moon, a runaway,
A rabbit running out of fear;
The bamboo hides me, night and day —
Look into my eyes — and forget your name;
The wave bends over and the world goes strange.
Look into my eyes — let the signal fall;
I am the full moon you can't see at all.

title: CROWNLESS
idea: Melbourne Bounce x Festival EDM x Hard Techno, 155 BPM. Dark, dominant, controlled festival weapon about authority without status: no crown, no throne, no permission. Start with a SIGNATURE INTRO DROP: industrial authority-stamp CLACK, vacuum pull, sub blast, then a unique syncopated 5-note minor melody on distorted supersaw/pluck. Huge offbeat Melbourne bass, brutal hard-techno kick and rumble, metallic fills, tight percussion, aggressive silence cuts. Deep male vocal, calm and intimidating, never theatrical. Hook: “No crown required.” TABLE is only one hidden callback to track #700: “I don’t need a crown, I just need my TABLE” followed quietly by “our holy table.” Drops must evolve: first establishes bounce + melody, second gets harder and more fractured, ALL drops are insane HARD on the bass. Melody wins.
text:
[SIGNATURE INTRO DROP]

[CLACK]

Wrong place.

You keep looking above my head
like power needs something shining.

[Vacuum pull]

Look at the room.

[SUB IMPACT]

Look who stopped talking.

[5-note melody enters]

NO CROWN REQUIRED.

[MAIN MELODY — 8 bars]

[VERSE 1]

I never needed gold
to make the silence turn.
Never needed a throne
to make the old rules burn.

No parade at the doorway.
No name carved in stone.
If you need a symbol to lead them,
you were never in control.

I walk in calm.
I leave a mark.
One quiet move
can change the dark.

No borrowed title.
No disguise.
You feel the pressure
before I arrive.

[CLACK]

That’s not ego.

That’s evidence.

[PRE-HOOK]

Take the gold away.
Take the throne away.
Take every little thing
you thought would make somebody great.

Leave the nerve.
Leave the weight.
Leave the one who never needed
permission at the gate.

No crown.
No throne.
No name carved into stone.

Still somehow—

everybody knows.

[HOOK]

I don’t need a crown
to make the whole room turn.
I don’t need a throne
to make the old rules burn.

Keep the gold.
Keep the title.
Keep the sound.

When the pressure walks in—

NO CROWN.

[DROP]

NO CROWN REQUIRED!

[Melbourne bounce bass]

No crown!

[Kick]

Still here!

No throne!

[Kick]

Still clear!

[Signature melody]

You want a symbol?

WATCH THIS.

[CLACK]

[DROP SWITCH]

CROWNLESS.

CROWNLESS.

No crown required.

[Silence]

REQUIRED.

[Kick slam]

[VERSE 2]

Everybody wants the photograph,
the victory pose,
the name.

Everybody wants the final light,
but nobody wants the weight.

They want authority delivered.
Confidence on loan.
Ten voices standing behind them
so they never stand alone.

Not me.

I built mine where nobody clapped.
Where every mistake
came biting back.

Where nobody cared
what story I told.

You either became it—

or you folded.

Keep your medals
in the cabinet.
Keep your labels
on the wall.

If removing all your decorations
makes you smaller—

you were never tall.

[LOW BREAK]

People confuse power
with proof of power.

A crown is proof
for people who need reminding.

I don’t.

I’d rather let them notice.

One by one.

Conversation stops.

Eyes shift.

Somebody moves their chair.

[Chair scrape]

Ah.

There it is.

[BUILD 2]

You can fake the image.
You can rent the room.
You can buy the entrance.
You can manufacture the boom.

But you can’t fake gravity.
And you can’t teach weight.

When somebody really owns the moment,
everybody feels it
before it’s too late.

No crown!

[Crowd]
NO CROWN!

No throne!

[Crowd]
NO THRONE!

No permission!

[Crowd]
NONE!

Then why’s the whole damn floor
waiting for one?

[CLACK]

MOVE.

[SECOND DROP — HARDER]

CROWNLESS!

[Hard techno kick]

CROWNLESS!

[Offbeat bass answers]

Left.
Right.
Lock.
Drive.

Put that pressure
in the room tonight.

No halo.
No robe.
No mythology.

Just bass.
Nerve.
Timing.

Authority.

[Melody variation]

No piece of metal
ever made me dangerous.

[Kick cut]

I was dangerous
before you named it.

[DROP RE-ENTRY]

CROWNLESS!

CROWNLESS!

[16 bars instrumental]

[FALSE BREAK]

[Room tone]

But there is one thing
I kept.

Not a crown.

Not a throne.

[Subtle melodic callback]

If you know—

you know.

I don’t need a crown...

I just need my TABLE.

[Distant whisper]

Our holy table.

[One beat silence]

Seven hundred.

That one wasn’t for everybody.

[FINAL BUILD]

Now forget the gold.
Forget the room.
Forget everything
you thought this song had to prove.

Bring back the pressure.
Bring back the sound.
Bring that five-note warning
back around.

First note.

Second.

Third.

Fourth.

[Pause]

FIFTH.

[Supersaw opens]

No crown above me.
No chain around me.
No throne behind me.
No hand that found me.

Built it myself.
Carried the weight.
Never needed permission
to enter the gate.

You wanted dominance?

Don’t decorate it.

Demonstrate it.

[Everything cuts]

No crown required.

[CLACK]

[FINAL DROP — MAXIMUM IMPACT]

CROWNLESS!

[Full melody + hardest kick + maximum bounce]

NO CROWN REQUIRED!

[Crowd]
REQUIRED!

NO THRONE REQUIRED!

[Crowd]
REQUIRED!

NO NAME REQUIRED!

[Crowd]
REQUIRED!

I came with nothing
over my head—

and somehow everybody
heard what I said.

No royal blood.
No sacred ground.
No little piece of gold
to pass around.

CROWN—
LESS!

CROWN—
LESS!

[Signature melody]

Whole floor move.
Whole room bend.
That five-note signal
hits again.

[CLACK]

No crown.

[Kick]

No throne.

[Kick]

No permission.

[Kick]

STILL IN CONTROL.

[Supersaw surge]

If you need the symbol,
you missed the point.

If you need the title,
you missed the voice.

If you need the throne
before you stand—

then sit back down.

You wouldn’t understand.

[CROWD CHANT]

CROWNLESS!
CROWNLESS!

title: That Is My Tactic
idea: Melodic Techno, Eurodance
text:
[Intro]

[Driving 909 kick beat]

[Subtle synth arpeggio rising]

[Fading in female vocal chops]
(Yeah...)

[Verse 1]
Flashing lights across the floor,
I step through the heavy door.
Caught your eyes from across the room,
Sudden rush, a sweet perfume.
I look away (look away), pretend I’m fine,
Hiding what is on my mind.
A hundred people in between,
But you’re the only one I’ve seen.

[Chorus]

[Explosive Beat Drop]

[Layered Harmonies]
You asked me why I looked away,
With every move I try to play.
I smile at you, the beat takes hold,
The simplest truth is getting told:
"That is my tactic!" (That’s my tactic!)
"That is my tactic!" (Got you coming closer now!)
"That is my tactic!"
Every glance was part of the plan.

[Verse 2]

[Acid Synth Line enters]
You’re stepping close, you call my name,
We're caught inside this rhythm game.
"Can I buy a drink?" you say,
As the bassline starts to sway.
Heartbeats racing fast tonight,
Everything just feels so right.
I turn my head, I glance again,
Waiting for the rush to begin.

[Chorus]

[Full Energy]

[Layered Harmonies]
You asked me why I looked away,
With every move I try to play.
I smile at you, the beat takes hold,
The simplest truth is getting told:
"That is my tactic!" (That’s my tactic!)
"That is my tactic!" (Got you coming closer now!)
"That is my tactic!"
Every glance was part of the plan.

[Interlude]

[Filter sweep down]

[Bass drops out, synth pad remains]

[Spoken Word, warm and confident]
You leaned in close and asked me...
"Why do you keep turning your head?"
I just laughed and whispered...

[Bridge]

[Building Snare Roll]

[Rising Melodic Synth Lead]
Catching your eyes, looking away (looking away),
Making you wonder, making you stay!
It wasn't chance, it was the spark,
A little light inside the dark!
(Here it comes... feel the rush!)

[Hook]

[Maximum Energy]
That is my tactic!
That is my tactic!
(Oh yeah, you fall in line!)

[Instrumental]

[Peak-Time Techno Drop]

[Fast Eurodance Lead Synth Melody]

[Heavy Driving Kick Drums]

[Outro]

[Beat slowly fading]

[Minimal synth arpeggio]
Now you’re standing right by me...
Just like I wanted it to be.
"That is my tactic..."
(Fading out...)

[End]
sung: I step through the heavy door.
Caught your eyes from across the room,
I look away (look away), pretend I’m fine,
Hiding what is on my mind.

title: Baltā lapas puse
idea: Pop-rock; warm expressive female lead vocal with clear diction, layered harmonies and group-style backing vocals; polished modern mix with forward vocals, energetic dynamics and wide chorus lift; bright acoustic guitar in verses, punchy bass, crisp drums, crunchy electric guitars, subtle synth pads and occasional whistle accents; mid-tempo driving 4/4 groove
text:
[Intro]
Šorīt atveru logu plaši,
vējš pār galdu baltu lapu šķir.
Vakar paliek kaut kur aiz muguras —
šodien viss vēl iespējams ir.
[1. pants]
Es tik ilgi rakstīju ar zīmuli
to, ko citi gaidīja no manis.
Dažreiz svītroju pati savus sapņus,
lai tik iederētos kāda stāstā.
Bet dzīve nav jau uzrakstīta grāmata,
kur beigas zināmas pirms ceļš vēl sākts.
Man priekšā balta lapas puse,
un šoreiz pati rakstīšu, kas nāks.
[Pirms piedziedājuma]
Nav jāzina, kur ceļš mani vedīs,
nav jāredz viss līdz galam man.
Man pietiek šodien sevī sajust:
Es vēl varu.
Es vēl gribu.
Es vēl eju tālāk.
[Piedziedājums]
BALTĀ LAPAS PUSE —
SĀKAS VISS NO JAUNA!
Bez vakardienas ēnām,
bez vārda — par vēlu.
BALTĀ LAPAS PUSE —
ES RAKSTU SAVU DZĪVI!
Ar sauli, vēju, mīlestību,
ar visu, kam es ticu!
Un, ja man jautās:
“Kas būs tālāk?”
Es pasmaidīšu:
“TO VĒL NEZINU…”
Bet pirmo rindu rakstu lieliem burtiem:
ES IZVĒLOS DZĪVOT!
[2. pants]
Varbūt būs vēl lietus aiz loga,
varbūt vējš kādu plānu sajauks.
Bet es vairs nebaidos no kļūdām —
arī tās reiz jaunus ceļus atklāj.
Es gribu rītus, kuros gribas celties,
un vakarus, ko negribas laist prom.
Es gribu cilvēkus, ar kuriem klusēt
ir tikpat skaisti kā līdz rītam runāt.
Es gribu dziesmas,
ceļus, jūru,
mazliet neprāta un daudz vairāk sevis.
Jo mana dzīve nav melnraksts —
ŠĪ IR VIENĪGĀ,
KO GRIBU PA ĪSTAM PIEREDZĒT.
[Pirms piedziedājuma]
Lai vecās lapas paliek grāmatā,
es tās vairs ārā neplēsīšu.
Tās arī mani atveda līdz šejienei —
bet nākamo…
ES RAKSTĪŠU CITĀDI.
[Piedziedājums]
BALTĀ LAPAS PUSE —
SĀKAS VISS NO JAUNA!
Bez vakardienas ēnām,
bez vārda — par vēlu.
BALTĀ LAPAS PUSE —
ES RAKSTU SAVU DZĪVI!
Ar sauli, vēju, mīlestību,
ar visu, kam es ticu!
Un, ja man jautās:
“Kas būs tālāk?”
Es pasmaidīšu:
“TO VĒL NEZINU…”
Bet pirmo rindu rakstu lieliem burtiem:
ES IZVĒLOS DZĪVOT!
[Bridge — klusāk, tikai balss un ģitāra]
Un varbūt skaistākais
vēl nemaz nav noticis.
Varbūt labākā dziesma
vēl nav uzrakstīta.
Varbūt cilvēki,
kurus reiz saukšu par savējiem,
vēl tikai nāk man pretī.
Un varbūt tieši tāpēc
dzīve atstāj mums baltas lapas —
nevis tāpēc, ka nekā nav…
bet tāpēc, ka
VĒL IR VIETA BRĪNUMIEM.
[Muzikāls kāpums]
Tad dod man vēju!
Dod man ceļu!
Dod vēl vienu rītu, ko satikt!
Es negribu zināt visas atbildes —
ES GRIBU DZĪVI, KO PAŠAI UZRAKSTĪT!
[Fināla piedziedājums]
BALTĀ LAPAS PUSE!
Šodien sākas no jauna!
BALTĀ LAPAS PUSE!
Un pildspalva ir manās rokās!
Es rakstīšu MĪLESTĪBU!
Es rakstīšu SAPŅUS!
Es rakstīšu CEĻUS, KUR VĒL NEESMU BIJUSI!
Un katru reizi,
kad dzīve pāršķirs lapu,
es vairs nejautāšu:
“Kāpēc?”
Es teikšu:
**“LABI.
RAKSTĀM TĀLĀK!”** ❤️‍🔥
[Outro]
Vējš pār galdu
baltu lapu šķir…
Es paņemu pildspalvu.
Un pirmo reizi
man nav bail no tā,
ka nezinu beigas.
Jo šis stāsts…
vēl tikai sākas. ✨
👑 VictoriousSong 👑

title: Velvet Summer
idea: Dream pop, cinematic alternative pop and melancholic baroque pop, around 82 BPM, 4/4. Warm vintage piano, soft brushed drums, deep rounded bass, tremolo electric guitar, lush string pads, subtle orchestral swells, analog tape warmth, dreamy reverb, distant ambient textures. Slow elegant groove, intimate verses, emotional pre-chorus, wide haunting chorus. Female lead vocal, breathy and intimate, smoky lower register with delicate highs, vulnerable and sensual, slightly detached delivery that becomes more emotional in the chorus. Natural human voice: realistic breathing, subtle pitch variation, organic timing, natural vibrato, small vocal imperfections, soft cracks, realistic dynamics, minimal pitch correction, no obvious Auto-Tune. Layered harmonies and distant backing vocals in the chorus. Atmosphere: nostalgic summer nights, doomed romance, old photographs, highways, motel lights, loneliness, beauty and sadness. Vintage Americana feeling, glamorous but fragile, poetic and cinematic. E

title: Blue Foundation – Eyes On Fire (Audio Paranoid Tribute Mix) [White Label]
idea: Progressive house: warehouse 4/4 kick, tech-funky bassline, vinyl claps, skipping hi-hats, minor-key industrial stabs, dark spacey pads and acoustic dub delays; tape saturation, vinyl warmth, tape hiss, analog space echo, deep low-to-mid filter sweeps and gritty vinyl fade-out; driving, tight 128 BPM peak-time groove in D minor, off-grid percussion locking hard; high-pitched female vocal with stuttered loops, haunting operatic layers, passionate chant, deep delay and reverb.
text:
[Intro - Audio Paranoid Off-Grid Build]
[Raw warehouse 4/4 kick drum drops off-grid and unsynced]
[Snapping vinyl claps and skipping hi-hats begin plavno plYvut out of time]
[Sudden lock - drums and tech-funky bassline snap and lock hard into a steady groove]
[Spacey low-to-mid filter sweeps slowly opening]
[Heavy tape saturation noise and analog vinyl warmth]
[Female voice echo filtered in deep delay]
"I'll find you..."

[Section - Stuttered Eyes On Fire Loop]
[Drums track stays tight and driving, bassline chugging hard]
[Stuttered female vocal loop, locked strictly to the downbeat]
I'll find you...
In the dark...
(I'll find... find you... in the dark...)

[Verse 1 - Slurred Shadow Phrasing]
[Only heavy tech-funky bassline and crisp vinyl claps]
[Haunting female vocal delivery, lagging behind the grid]
I'll find you... chords of the guitar
No-one... guides me... in the dark
I'm your moon... and your star
I'll find you... no matter how far

[The Lock - Resonant Audio Paranoid Breakdown]
[Kick drum stops instantly, creating a stark gap with acoustic dub delays]
[Tech-funky bassline modulates lower, vibrating the sub-woofer under deep filter sweeps]
[Haunting operatic layers drift beautifully through deep space delay]
[Female vocal stutter looping hard like a broken hardware sampler]
"Eyes on fire..."
"Your eyes on fire..."
(on fire... fire... fire...)

[Build Up - Deep Groove Tension]
[Snapping vinyl claps increase pacing, frantic filtered percussion rolls layer in]
[Analog space echo fx panning wildly left and right, increasing acoustic pressure]
[The mantra repeating with deep, cold, desperate energy]
I'll find you...
Your eyes on fire...
[Abrupt mute]

[Main Peak - Ultimate Kleinenberg Climax]
[Full energy drop, massive punishing 2002 progressive tech-funk house groove returns]
[Heavy warehouse kick and monstrous tech-funky bassline driving hard together]
[Minor-key dark industrial stabs slashing the peak-time D-minor grid]
[High-pitched passionate female vocal chant cutting through the wall of sound]
EYES ON FIRE!
YOUR EYES ON FIRE!
(on fire... fire... fire...)

[Chorus - Final Climax Groove Continuation]
[The tech-funky bassline and flat 4/4 kick maintain the tight steady groove]
[Dark spacey pads wash over the background tones]
I'm your moon... and your star...
Your eyes on fire...

[Outro - Extended White Label DJ Tail]
[All synthetic sweeps and stabs dissolve into infinite acoustic dub delays and tape hiss]
[The off-grid female vocal completely fades into a deep cloud of reverb]
[Only the solid warehouse kick, skipping hi-hats, and tech-funky bass remain]
[Long classic 2002 club vinyl fade out with gritty fade to total silence]
[End]

Если это огонь — не туши до утра.
Мы так близко, что слышим друг друга
Даже там, где молчит тишина.

[Outro]
Ближе...
Ещё ближе...
Не отпускай.
Пока мы дышим —
Нас не потерять.

that’s what it was.

A hiding place,

title: My Nose Knows the Way
idea: modern cinematic indie pop, dark alt-pop, trip-hop
text:
[Intro]
My little boy...
Where did you go...
[Verse 1]
They brought me to him — just a bundle of fur,
With clumsy soft paws and a wondering stare.
He held me so tight as I started to purr,
And light filled the room and the quiet cold air.
We chased an old ball across rugs on the floor,
He whispered: “Come here, little friend, you’re so small.”
And whenever he cried by his bedroom door,
I’d nudge at his cheek till the tears didn’t fall.
I slept by his bedside all curled in a ring,
Guarding his dreams till the morning would shine.
My sun and my leash and my everything,
The only true boy in this whole world of mine.
[Pre-Chorus]
Then doctors in white came and said: “He can’t stay,
The fur makes him cough and it’s hard for his breath.
We’re sorry, but take the young puppy away...”
And autumn crept in with its cold, freezing breath.
They drove me away as I fought for the door,
Back to his blanket, the steps that I knew.
His mother kept whispering down to the floor:
“Forgive us, sweet dog, it’s not because of you...”
[Chorus]
Where are you, my boy? I am sniffing each gate,
Tracing your scent in the cold and the gray.
I’m running through alleys and days as I wait,
I’ll find you, I know that my nose knows the way!
[Post-Chorus]
I’ll find the way...
My nose knows the way...
[Verse 2]
[Stripped back, intimate guitar and close-mic voice]
A stranger’s kind house took me into their care,
With bowls made of steel and a bed soft and wide.
Yet all through the days I would wait by the stair,
Unable to welcome the comfort inside.
They stroked on my neck saying: “Hush now, good boy,”
And rolled by my muzzle a red rubber toy.
No laughter in toys and no warmth in the grain,
And every long night dragged me back to the rain.
I chewed through the fence and I tore at the lead,
Not wicked or wild, just broken and lost.
A puppy in desperate, solitary need,
Retracing your scent whatever the cost.
[Pre-Chorus 2]
Through alleys and subways, through gasoline haze,
Cold glass and puddles and shadows unseen.
I searched the whole city for nights and for days:
Where are you, my boy, where on earth have you been?
I slept under benches, I shivered in doorways,
They shouted: “Get out, go away from our street!”
Yet colder the wind on the wandering pathways,
The brighter the hope that we soon were to meet.
[Chorus 2]
Where are you, my boy? Through the darkness and glare,
I search for the one scent no winter could fray.
I stumble and freeze, but I run through the air,
I’ll find you, I know that my nose knows the way!
[Bridge]
I remember the swings and the sandbox of old,
The stick that you threw in the yard full of grace.
The warmth of your palms and the morning time cold,
And how you would whisper: “It’s going to be safe.”
They yell: “Dirty stray!” and I lower my tail,
Yet onward I go through the sorrow and pain.
As long as your trace still endures on the gale,
As long as I breathe, I will seek you again.
I ask for no roof, no sweet bowl on the floor,
No fireside warmth in the middle of storm.
Just stay alive, boy, and be well evermore,
And I’ll catch your scent on the wind and stay warm.
[Final Chorus]
Where are you, my boy? I check every backyard,
I search for your scent that will never decay.
Through seasons and concrete and fences so hard,
I’ll find you, as long as my nose knows the way!
[Repeat Final Chorus]
Where are you, my boy? I am sniffing each home,
I carry your scent through the darkness and gray.
Though night is behind and cold rain starts to roam,
I know I will find you... my nose knows the way!
[Outro]
Maybe you’ve grown and you’re far from my reach,
Maybe you lost that small collar we wore.
I still feel your palm and your gentle soft speech,
I’m still your young puppy, your dog evermore.
[Whispered, very close to mic]
Where are you, my boy...
I’ll find you...
My nose knows the way.
[End]

idea: neurohop, glitch-hop, funky glitch, 101 BPM, B minor, pure instrumental, sampling and remixing lead synthesizer from audio input into swung funk groove, robotic vocoder delivery for sparse percussive vocal chops, liquid Reese neuro-bass foundation with rubbery vowel formant filter sweeps, clean dedicated sub-bass layer locked to kick, Fender Rhodes electric piano warm vintage 7th chord comping, rhythmic muted funk guitar scratches in background, swung unquantized hip-hop breakbeat with wood-crack snare on offbeats, dense syncopated ghost note percussion and organic tactile foley clicks, violent sidechain compression pumping, high-speed granular micro-glitch chops, cavernous Lexicon reverb on keys, uncompressed wide dynamic range, dusty vinyl crackle, playful aggressive funk swagger, no brass stabs, no lead vocals, no singing, no live audience, no applause

[Intro. dusty vinyl crackle. warm Fender Rhodes electric piano comping lush 7th chords. clean muted funk guitar scratches. 101 BPM. B minor. no drums yet.]

[Sampled One-Shot. robotic vocoder voice. single percussive hit. no looping.]
Hey!

[Textural Shift. bass modulation mutates with swept notch filters. rhythmic muted funk guitar chops tight in the pocket. violent sidechain compression pumping.]

[Atmospheric Breakdown. drums cut completely. Rhodes chords sustaining warm in cavernous Lexicon reverb bloom. delicate foley clicks and shakers suspended.]

[Build. acoustic kick returns on downbeats. syncopated ghost note snare rolls escalating. granular micro-glitch buffer repeats. energy surging into the drop.]

Watch out!

[Sampled One-Shot. robotic vocoder voice. explosive transition accent. no looping.]
Check this!

[Climax Peak. all hardware locked in aggressive funk swagger. granular glitch chops scattering wide across stereo field.]

[Outro. drums strip back to acoustic thud. Rhodes chords decaying slow over vinyl crackle. single liquid bass squelch bleeding into silence.]

title: Peace
idea: EllJay
text:
[Verse 1]
I’ve been stuck in a cycle of overthinking, Lost in the noise and the second-guessing. Running on empty, past every warning, Looking for peace while the days keep turning.
I gave too much, now I’m losing connection, Smile on cue, hide the cracks in expression. Somewhere between all the pressure and tension, I lost myself chasing everybody’s acceptance.
[Pre-Chorus]
Too much noise, barely any silence, Too much weight, barely any guidance. There’s something underneath this skin, A part of me waiting to shine again.
[Chorus]
 I need peace, peace of mind, I need a break from the life I’m behind. I’ve been searching for a sign, For the person I left somewhere in time.
I need peace, peace, peace tonight, Need to get the spark back into my eyes. I don’t need a brand-new perfect life, I need to find myself, feel alive.
[Verse 2]
 Everybody needs something, constant demands, I keep giving pieces of me, with open hands. Trying to live up to expectations, While losing myself in complications.
I’ve been living on autopilot, repetition, Same four walls and the same old condition. Looking in the mirror, searching for recognition, Trying to remember my own definition.
[Pre-Chorus ]
Too much noise, barely any silence, Too much weight, barely any guidance. There’s something underneath this skin, A part of me waiting to begin.
[Chorus]
I need peace, peace of mind, I need a break from the life I’m behind. I’ve been searching for a sign, For the person I left somewhere in time.
I need peace, peace, peace tonight, Need to get the spark back into my eyes. I don’t need a brand-new, perfect life, I need to find myself, feel alive.
Bridge I’ve spent too long trying to keep the balance, Carrying weight that was never mine to manage. Strip away the noise, the expectation, Leave room for a little restoration.
Let the silence settle through me, Let the mirror show the truth to me.
[Final Chorus] 
I need peace, peace, peace of mind, I need to leave all that weight behind. I’ve been searching for a sign, Realised the missing piece was mine.
I need peace, peace, peace tonight, Need to see that spark back in my eyes. I don’t need a brand-new perfect life, I need to find myself, feel alive.
[Outro]
Piece by piece, I’m finding me. Breath by breath, I’m finding peace.

title: Szacunek i zaufanie
idea: Modern dark electronic rap / alternative hip-hop, 92 BPM, deep male baritone with calm, controlled and confident delivery, dry close-mic vocal, subtle spoken-sung phrasing. Heavy analog sub bass, punchy dry drums, sparse piano, dark atmospheric synths, restrained electric guitar textures and minimal electronic percussion. Verses should feel observant, intelligent and detached, with strong rhythmic phrasing and space between lines. Chorus must be memorable, powerful and slightly anthemic, supported by layered low male backing vocals. Avoid aggressive shouting. The production should communicate independence, self-control, emotional discipline and quiet confidence rather than arrogance. Add exactly two instrumental interludes: first minimal and hypnotic, second darker and cinematic with rising tension. Final section should feel strong but calm, ending with a sparse bass-and-piano outro.
text:
Respect and Trust

[Intro]
I don't look for the crowd,
I am not afraid to be alone.
Peace tastes much better
than the noise of so many things.

[Verse 1]
A single conversation is enough
to know who is standing here.
I don't read from someone's words,
I look closer at the gesture.
I don't trust right away,
time shows what is really going on.
Words can be beautiful,
but actions speak the truth.

[Chorus]
I am rare,
because I don't chase the crowd.
I don't need applause
to know who I am.
When respect vanishes,
I don't stay by force.
I leave without any drama.
And that is exactly why I am rare.

[Verse 2]
I don't have to be everywhere,
I don't have to be first.
Not everyone who smiles
has honest intentions.
I observe people
before I let them closer.
I don't ask for promises
I look at what they do when no one is watching.

[Verse 3]
I don't hold back people
who want to leave on their own.
I don't beg for attention,
I don't trade my principles.
I have my own path,
though it's not always straight.
I'd rather walk alone
than walk against myself.

[Chorus]
I am rare,
because I don't chase the crowd.
I don't need applause
to know who I am.
When respect vanishes,
I don't stay by force.
I leave without any drama.
And that is exactly why I am rare.

[Bridge]
Call me whatever you want...
I don't need a label...
to know my own worth...

[Final Chorus]
I am rare,
because I protect my peace.
I don't look for applause,
I don't need the crowd.
I build trust through actions,
respect must work both ways.
And when either one vanishes
there is nothing left to defend.

[Outro]
I am not lonely.
I am just doing well on my own.
Because sometimes,
the ultimate luxury...
Is your own peace...
[end]

title: Three Notes
idea: chamber-folk, art-folk
text:
[project:{TR-29}|{THREE-NOTES}]
[intent:{chamber-folk}|{field-recorded forest}|{three-note avian motif}|{soft dread}]
[tempo:78][key:A minor][time:4/4]
[rule:{strings close+dry}|{field recordings rhythmic}|{silence structural}|{no synthetic ambience}|{no polished sheen}]

[SYS-00:{architecture}]
[form:{field opening}|{path entry}|{three-note fixation}|{light shift}|{fox memory}|{bird conversation}|{unfinished sentence}|{string feature}|{memory fracture}|{field residue}]
[groove:{slow breathing 4/4}|{bird calls create syncopation}|{bow pressure replaces percussion}]

[SYS-01:{field recording}]
[recorder:{Sound Devices MixPre-6 II}|{32-bit float}]
[array:{Sennheiser MKH 8040 pair}|{ORTF}|{Rycote Cyclone}]
[secondary:{DPA 4060 CORE pair}|{low foliage placement}]
[sources:{real birds}|{leaves}|{natural wind}]
[editing:{continuous takes}|{real three-note calls retained}|{no pitch replacement}|{no synthetic birds}]
[role:{irregular percussion}|{motif source}|{outro foreground}]

[SYS-02:{close viola}]
[instrument:{Eastman VA305 viola}|{acoustic}]
[technique:{dry détaché}|{restrained rosin bite}|{pressure swells}|{uneasy slides}|{fragile harmonics}]
[capture:{Schoeps CMC6/MK4}|{Grace Design m201}]
[role:{first string voice}|{three-note imitation}|{feature lead opening}]

[SYS-03:{close acoustic cello}]
[instrument:{Jay Haide l'Ancienne Montagnana-model cello}|{4-string acoustic}]
[technique:{rough low détaché}|{slow portamento}|{pressure bloom}|{fragile harmonics}]
[capture:{DPA 4011A}|{Millennia HV-3D}]
[role:{low dread}|{phrase-end replies}|{feature lead handoff}]

[SYS-04:{felt piano+acoustic guitar}]
[piano:{Yamaha U1 upright}|{felt practice rail engaged}|{Neumann KM84 pair}]
[piano technique:{single notes}|{soft dyads}|{wide rests}|{pedal noise retained}]
[guitar:{Martin 00-18}|{Martin Retro Monel 12-54}|{Neumann KM84}]
[guitar technique:{thumb pulse}|{muted brush}|{isolated harmonic}|{rare support only}]

[SYS-05:{voice+room}]
[voice:{Tarja R2p9v6.0}]
[room:{small untreated timber room}|{0.5-0.8s natural decay}|{no plate}]
[layering:{solo throughout}|{light close unison double final section only}]
[geometry:{voice front}|{viola left-center}|{cello right-center}|{piano rear-left}|{guitar rear-right}|{field wide}]
[master:{dry}|{human}|{minimal compression}|{true peak -1dB}]

[FORM-FIELD:{forest before language}]
[field:{high bird chirping}|{soft wind}|{descending trill}|{rustling leaves}]
[music:{absent}]

[FORM-I:{path entry}]
[piano:{two felt notes separated by silence}]
[cello:{one distant harmonic}]
[delivery:{intimate}|{clearly audible}]

I walked in because the path looked soft.
It wasn’t.
The ground kept giving under my shoes
like it was thinking about swallowing me
and then changing its mind.
I stood still for a second just to see if it would decide.
It didn’t.
So I kept going.

[field:{distant bird calls}]

[FORM-V1:{three-note fixation}]
[viola:{close dry replies}]
[cello:{low pressure shadow}]
[field:{three-note bird motif between phrases}]

There’s a bird doing the same three notes over and over
like it’s trying to remember something it never actually knew.
I start matching it under my breath
and suddenly I can’t tell which one of us started it.
My mouth is doing the notes
but the feeling in my chest isn’t mine anymore.
It belongs to the bird
or to the trees
or to whoever left this path here and forgot to finish it.

[field:{three-note call}]
[viola:{imitates once}|{slightly late}]

[FORM-L1:{wrong light}]
[piano:{brighter four-bar figure}]
[cello:{low answer beneath voice}]
[guitar:{soft thumb pulse}]

The trees here don’t care if you’re lost.
They just keep standing in the exact same places
while you invent reasons why the light feels wrong.
I tried counting them once.
Got to fourteen
and then the numbers started feeling sticky
so I stopped.

[FORM-V2:{fox memory}]
[strings:{more physical}|{still sparse}]
[field:{wind moves through phrase gaps}]

I saw a fox once.
Or I thought I did.
It looked at me like I was the story someone else was telling
and then it was gone.
I kept walking anyway.
My socks were wet.
I hated that more than the fox.
There was a moment where I almost turned around
but the path behind me already looked like it belonged to a different person.
So I stayed.

[FORM-M:{conversation with birds}]
[delivery:{near-spoken}]
[field:{birds foregrounded}]
[viola:{one pressure tone after selected fragments}]

I started talking out loud.
Not full sentences.
Just pieces.
Three notes.
Again.
Why that shape.
The wind took most of it.
The leaves took the rest.
Nothing answered
but the same bird kept offering the motif
like it was the only thing it knew how to give.

[FORM-BR:{unfinished sentence}]
[piano:{felt notes beneath birds}]
[strings:{absent first half}]
[delivery:{almost spoken}]

You ever notice how forests never actually finish a sentence?
They just trail off into wind
and leave you holding the end of it like an idiot.
I held it for a long time.
Long enough that my hands got cold.
Long enough that I started wondering
if the three-note bird was actually me from some other afternoon
trying to get my attention and failing.

[FORM-FEATURE:{motif absorption}|{16 bars}]
[stage 1:{viola states a dry three-note cell with long gaps}|{real bird answers independently}]
[stage 2:{cello enters beneath on low open resonance}|{piano reduces to isolated attacks}]
[stage 3:{viola stretches motif into unstable held tones}|{cello answers with pressure-heavy fragments}]
[stage 4:{bird timing and string timing drift apart}|{wind remains unedited}]
[stage 5:{piano and guitar disappear}|{viola+cello mirror motif one octave apart}]
[stage 6:{both strings stop together}|{bird continues alone}]
[ending:{no cadence}|{field recording owns the silence}]
[law:{motif recognition over virtuosity}|{no fast bowing}]

[FORM-FINAL:{memory rewriting itself}]
[strings:{warmer but cracked}]
[piano:{soft dyads}]
[layering:{close unison double enters only near ending}]

I don’t know how long I stayed.
Long enough for the three-note bird to get bored of me.
Long enough to realise I was narrating the whole thing in my head
like it was already a memory I would mess up later.
I will mess it up later.
I’ll say the fox looked kind.
I’ll say the light was golden.
I’ll leave out the part where I almost sat down
and let the ground finish what it started.

[OUTRO:{recording remains}]
[piano:{gone}]
[strings:{withdraw completely}]
[field:{high bird chirping}|{wind}|{descending trill}|{rustling leaves}|{distant calls}]

[delivery:{voice alone}|{almost spoken}]

I’m still here.
Or I’m not.
The recording doesn’t care either way.
It just keeps the three notes
and the wind
and the small sound of someone who walked in
and never quite walked out.

[field:{final three-note bird call}|{no musical answer}|{wind into silence}]
[MARINATE:{10-16s}|{unaltered forest take}|{natural wind}|{distant calls}]
[TERMINATE:{field recording ends naturally}|{no fade automation}]

The ground kept giving under my shoes
like it was thinking about swallowing me
I stood still for a second just to see if it would decide.

text:
Posadziłam je w głębi ogrodu,
 kiedy pachniał świeży maj,
Śmiałam się, że będzie wiedzieć,
gdy do miłości znajdę powód.

Przywiązałam do gałęzi
czerwoną wstążkę z tamtych dni,
a ono rosło razem ze mną,
choć nie mówiło nic.


Moje drzewko miłości,
czemu milkniesz pośród liści?
Kiedy kochałam, płonąłeś
jak zachód słońca nad jabłonią.

Dziś czerwienisz się rzadziej,
chociaż umierasz- masz resztkę koloru.
Czy to znak, że już nic dobrego
nie czeka mnie, nie będzie wyboru.



Pamiętam jesień pod balkonem,
każdy liść był czerwony, jak mały żar,
wracałam późno, a ty świeciłeś
mi prosto w twarz.

Potem dni miały mniej czerwieni,
mniej powodów, żeby trwać,
lecz zostawały złote brzegi,
których znaczenia ...
nie umiałam nazwać


Moje drzewko miłości,
czemu milkniesz pośród liści?
Kiedy kochałam, płonąłeś
jak zachód słońca nad jabłonią.

Dziś czerwienisz się rzadziej,
chociaż umierasz- masz kolor w dłoniach.
Czy to znak, że już nic dobrego
nie czeka mnie po drodze?




Od dwóch miesięcy ziemia przy tobie.
Jest zbyt cicha, podlewana a zbyt sucha,
konar trzyma się jeszcze nieba,
choć kora pęka, jak serce na pół.

Może miłość nie umiera
w jednej chwili, jak inne rzeczy proste
może schodzi głębiej, pod korzenie,
żeby wrócić na nowo na wiosnę.


Moje drzewko miłości,
jeśli możesz, zostań chwilę.
Nie obiecuj mi już ognia,
wystarczy jeden zielony liść.
mały listek nadziei.

Bo gdy serce traci lato,
nie znaczy, że traci przyszłość.
Może dobro idzie wolno,
lecz wciąż zna mój adres i miłość.


Jutro znów podleję ziemię,
choć nie wiem, czy odpowie.
A jeśli nie zakwitniesz,
może znajdę coś w życiu i....

posadzę inne  obok ciebie.

I thought we'd always have another chance to meet, so I left the words I wanted to say for tomorrow. “Have you been doing okay?” “What have you been up to?” Those ordinary little conversations have become precious memories now. idea: Philosophical satirical trip-hop, dark funky downtempo, alternative electronic spoken-word, humorous cinematic groove, subtle funk bass, dry punchy drums, warm analog synths, muted electric guitar accents, playful perfume-ad atmosphere, deep controlled low end, wide stereo field, professional modern mastering. Привет, мужики, у меня к вам вопрос.
Я вот думаю купить мужские духи,
Но со сладким вкусом они были чтоб,
Ибо не люблю я резкие запахи.
У некоторых мужских одеколонов
Резкий запах бьёт прямо в нос.
Так что это типа не по понятиям?
Сладкий запах - ярмо гея, и ты не вхож?

Скажите мне, это нормально?
Мужики, ну ответьте же на вопрос.
Скажите мне, это реально?
Или я уже... до гея дорос?
Скажите мне, это нормально,
Если сладко пахнет твой парфюм?
Ты не стал от этого менее брутальным.
И геи здесь вообще ни при чём.

Настоящий мужик вонять должен потом,
Чтоб дезодорантом забрызгать его поверх.
Желательно, конечно, Олд Спайсом стоковым.
Вкусно пахнуть мужчине сложно… «А зачем?»
Кто-то скажет: «Я не покупал себе ничего,
А пахну так, как мне скажет жена».
Это такие плюсы быть под каблуком…
И многим ведь это очень даже нравится.

Но если сам себе ты выбрать не можешь
Ни запах, ни цвет, или собственный путь,
То кто тогда решает, каким будешь всё же?
И почему обязательно эту вонь тянуть?

Скажите мне, это нормально,
Если сладко пахнет твой парфюм?
Ты не стал от этого менее брутальным.
И геи здесь вообще ни при чём.

Но есть, вообще-то, и другое мнение
О том, что это, конечно, нормально.
В каждом есть мужское и женское,
Когда сладкого вкуса хочется аномально.
Здесь вопрос на поверхность выходит один:
Так насколько мы слушаем всегда себя?
Мы хотим так сильно казаться брутальными
И при этом пахнуть как вонючая свинья.

На вопрос тот ответ каждый даст себе сам:
Что важно для тебя - правда или обман?
Не нужно слепо идти по чужим следам,
Иначе в какой-то миг тебя порвёт пополам.

Скажите мне, это нормально?
Мужики, ну ответьте же на вопрос.
Я отвечу: конечно, да, друг мой.
И геи здесь вообще ни при чём.
Скажите мне, это нормально,
Если сладко пахнет твой парфюм?
Ты не стал от этого менее брутальным.
И геи здесь вообще ни при чём.

Пахни чем хочешь, брат.
Главное - чтобы нравилось тебе.
А остальное… Это уже не парфюм.
Это комплексы…. чужие.
